summary: IceCure Medical Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting a private placement of pre-funded warrants and Series D/E warrants with an institutional investor. The combined purchase price is $2.9999 per pre-funded warrant and accompanying warrants, implying gross proceeds of approximately $5.5 million. Pre-funded warrants are exercisable at $0.0001; Series D/E warrants at $3.00, expiring in five years and one year respectively. The company also amended existing Series B/C warrants to reduce exercise price from $16.50 to $3.00, subject to shareholder approval. A.G.P. acted as placement agent. The issuance increases potential share overhang upon exercise; watch for dilution effects and registration statement effectiveness timeline.
